name: Painted in ink and colour, backed and mounted (a Chinese painting on silk or paper)

roughness.note: No gloss of a mounted painting was read: a first value between a matte paper and a silk's soft sheen.

roughnessAcross.source: the image carries what grain the face shows

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.note: A first value for the weave or the fibres under the ink.

relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image
